# Vias Media

> Vias Media is a one-person web design studio in Neubrandenburg, Germany, building fast, hand-coded websites and local SEO for small businesses and tradespeople (Handwerksbetriebe) in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

## Services

- [Webagentur Neubrandenburg](https://viasmedia.com/webagentur-neubrandenburg.html): Local landing page — what a web agency in Neubrandenburg does differently, the four-step process, price range, an honest comparison of website builders vs. large agencies vs. Vias Media, references, service area towns and seven FAQs.
- [Leistungen / Services](https://viasmedia.com/services.html): Websites, online shops and landing pages; web development, local SEO and AI visibility, digital consulting (by phone or on site), accessibility audits (WCAG 2.2 / BFSG) and ongoing support with hosting on servers in Germany — with the four-stage fixed-price project process (Discover, Design, Develop, Grow).
- [Webdesign Neubrandenburg (homepage)](https://viasmedia.com/): What Vias Media does, who it serves, the six services, four case studies, client reviews, and FAQs on pricing, timelines, on-site meetings, hosting in Germany and post-launch support. One personal contact based in Neubrandenburg; every site is accessible under the BFSG.
- [Kontakt / Contact](https://viasmedia.com/contact.html): Project enquiry form and direct contact details. Every enquiry gets a reply within one business day; the first consultation is free.

## Case Studies

- [Projekte / Work](https://viasmedia.com/work.html): Index of five client case studies with the measured result for each.
- [Eagle Air HVAC](https://viasmedia.com/work-eagle-air.html): Relaunch of a Sarasota, Florida HVAC contractor's brochure site as a mobile-first lead engine — 2x enquiries, 98 Lighthouse performance score.
- [Akkerman Stroy](https://viasmedia.com/work-akkerman-stroy.html): Digital presence and multi-city local SEO for a Berlin/Mecklenburg-Vorpommern renovation contractor — +140% organic traffic.
- [Luxe Bouquets](https://viasmedia.com/work-luxe-bouquets.html): Online shop build for a florist — +85% online orders.
- [Safari](https://viasmedia.com/work-safari.html): Online fashion shop redesign — +38% conversion rate.
- [Jesus Punkt](https://viasmedia.com/work-jesus-punkt.html): Trilingual (German/English/Ukrainian) website for a church in Neubrandenburg, with events synced automatically from ChurchTools and an online donation-receipt form.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://viasmedia.com/blog): German-language articles on websites, local visibility and online marketing for small businesses in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
- [Empfiehlt ChatGPT Ihren Betrieb? Wie Handwerker in KI-Antworten auftauchen](https://viasmedia.com/blog/ki-chatgpt-handwerker-gefunden-werden): How German trade businesses get recommended in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Perplexity) — Bitkom 2026 usage figures, which sources AI assistants draw on for local businesses, the website signals that matter (clear service + town pages, consistent NAP, reviews, schema.org LocalBusiness subtypes, AI crawler access) and a 5-minute self-test.
- [Gibt es Förderung für die Website eines Handwerksbetriebs? Stand Oktober 2026 in MV](https://viasmedia.com/blog/foerderung-website-handwerk-mv): Honest overview (October 2026) of funding for a trade business website in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern — federal go-digital and Digital Jetzt ended, the state Digitalisierungsförderung Mittelstand MV (up to 50 %, max EUR 50,000, min. ~EUR 30,000 project, ran to 30 June 2026), BAFA consulting grant at 80 % (max EUR 2,800) until 31 Dec 2026, and free digitalisation advice from the Handwerkskammer.
- [Referenzfotos auf der Website: Was Handwerker zeigen dürfen – und wie Bilder Aufträge bringen](https://viasmedia.com/blog/referenzfotos-handwerker-website-erlaubt): When German trade businesses may publish customer project photos as website references — consent under GDPR and KUG, private homes and addresses, employee photos and photo copyright, drone shots (BGH I ZR 67/23), stripping GPS metadata — plus how to build project pages that rank and sell.
- [Impressum für Handwerksbetriebe: Diese Pflichtangaben gehören hinein (Stand 2026)](https://viasmedia.com/blog/impressum-handwerksbetrieb-pflichtangaben): Checklist of mandatory imprint (Impressum) details for German trade businesses under § 5 DDG as of 2026 — general fields, registers and tax IDs, when chamber and professional title are required (health trades), removal of the EU ODR platform link since 20 July 2025, consumer dispute notice for 10+ employees, social media profiles and Abmahnung risk.
- [Mehr Google-Bewertungen bekommen: Ein Ablauf für Handwerksbetriebe, der wirklich funktioniert](https://viasmedia.com/blog/google-bewertungen-bekommen-handwerker): A practical routine for German trade businesses to get more Google reviews — timing, QR code and message templates, how to answer negative reviews, what is prohibited (incentives, review gating, fake reviews under UWG) and the § 5b UWG disclosure when showing reviews on the own website.
- [Azubis und Mitarbeiter finden: Warum Handwerksbetriebe eine Karriereseite brauchen](https://viasmedia.com/blog/azubis-mitarbeiter-finden-handwerk-karriereseite): How German trade businesses can recruit apprentices and staff with an own careers page — 2025 apprenticeship figures, what applicants search for locally, Google for Jobs (JobPosting structured data), and a checklist for a careers page that converts on a phone.
- [MyHammer, Check24 & Co.: Was Handwerker für Aufträge wirklich bezahlen](https://viasmedia.com/blog/myhammer-check24-kosten-handwerker): What German trade portals (MyHammer, Check24 Profis) cost a Handwerksbetrieb per won job — subscription, per-lead fees, shared leads — with a worked cost-per-job calculation and when an own website is cheaper.
- [BFSG: Muss meine Website jetzt barrierefrei sein?](https://viasmedia.com/blog/bfsg-barrierefreie-website-pflicht): Who the German Accessibility Act (BFSG, in force since 28 June 2025) applies to, the micro-enterprise exemption, the WCAG requirements, penalties, and a 10-minute self-test.
- [Drei Website-Fehler, die Anfragen kosten — und wie Sie sie selbst prüfen](https://viasmedia.com/blog/website-fehler-die-kunden-kosten): Slow loading, weak mobile view and no clear next step — how each costs enquiries and how a business owner can test for it in 10 minutes.
- [Handwerk, Arztpraxis, Ferienwohnung: Was Betriebe an der Seenplatte von ihrer Website brauchen](https://viasmedia.com/blog/website-handwerk-praxis-ferienwohnung-seenplatte): What trades, medical practices and holiday rentals in the Mecklenburg Lake District each need from their website, including legal requirements and direct-booking economics.
- [Website-Wartung: Was nach dem Launch wirklich gepflegt werden muss](https://viasmedia.com/blog/website-wartung-sicherheit): What a website needs after launch — updates, TLS certificate lifetimes, backups, DDG/TDDDG legal updates, form monitoring — and what owners can do themselves.
- [Wie Handwerksbetriebe bei Google gefunden werden](https://viasmedia.com/blog/wie-handwerker-bei-google-gefunden-werden): Local SEO for trade businesses: Google Business Profile setup, NAP consistency, pages per service and town, reviews, and a realistic 3–6 month timeline.
- [Warum braucht ein Unternehmen eine Webseite?](https://viasmedia.com/blog/warum-eine-website-fuer-kleine-betriebe-wichtig-ist): Why small trade businesses lose customers without a website, and what a customer checks before calling.
- [Was kostet eine Website für ein kleines Unternehmen in Neubrandenburg?](https://viasmedia.com/blog/was-kostet-eine-website): Honest price ranges for a professional small-business website in Neubrandenburg and what actually drives the cost up or down.

## Key Facts

- Business: Vias Media — web design and web development studio (ProfessionalService)
- Founder and sole operator: Mykhailo Sibahatov
- Location: Robert-Koch-Str. 15, 17036 Neubrandenburg, Germany
- Service area: Neubrandenburg, the Mecklenburgische Seenplatte district and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; remote clients accepted
- Specialisation: small businesses and Handwerksbetriebe (trades) — HVAC, construction and renovation, retail, local services
- Pricing model: fixed price per project, quoted after a free consultation — never hourly
- Typical delivery time: 2–4 weeks from kickoff to launch for a small-business website
- Local SEO is included in every project, not sold as an add-on
- Languages: German (default) and English — the site serves both from the same URLs
- Technology: hand-coded static HTML/CSS/JS, no page builders, deployed on Vercel
